headword: {関東大震災|かんとうだいしんさい}
reading: かんとうだいしんさい

definitions.explanation: The magnitude 7.9 earthquake that struck the Tokyo and Yokohama region at 11:58 a.m. on 1 September 1923. Fires spreading from lunchtime cooking stoves destroyed much of both cities, and more than 100,000 people died.

examples.english: Disaster Prevention Day on 1 September comes from the date of the Great Kantō Earthquake.

notes:
Japan's Disaster Prevention Day (⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧), on 1 September, marks the earthquake, and schools and offices hold evacuation drills on or near it. In the chaos that followed, mobs and vigilante groups killed many Korean residents, a part of the history that is still debated.
